svg.text: 1 - GENERAL ARRANGEMENT PLAN (BRIDGE DECK 'C', Fr120-Fr131 STBD)
SHIP SIDE SHELL - STBD, 8 mm plate, frames @ 700 mm, 75 mm mineral wool + lining
SHIP SIDE SHELL - STBD, 8 mm plate, frames @ 700 mm, 75 mm mineral wool + lining
Feeder 3x2.5 mm² from ACC-DB-03 (230 V 60 Hz 1~), EM light 2x1.5 mm² 24 V DC from EM-DB; IT/IS cables segregated
SHIP SIDE SHELL - STBD, 8 mm plate, frames @ 700 mm, 75 mm mineral wool + lining
CW DN15 Cu • HW DN15 Cu (insul.) • GW DN50 • BW DN100
Ventilation: SA from AHU-2 via FCU ≥ 6 ACH; bath EA 50 m³/h to sanitary exhaust fan (cabin under-pressure). Fire dampers at A-class boundary only.
CEILING VOID 2300-2850: cable trays, CW/HW branches, SA duct Ø160
Deck 12 mm on frames; 60 mm floating floor (vibration isolated, IMO MSC.337(91) ≤ 55 dB(A))
Corridor bulkhead B-15 / joiner panels 50 mm mineral wool, FTP Code Part 3
Lighting fixture LED 230 V (IP20 / IP44 in bath)
Socket outlet 230 V 16 A Schuko, RCBO 30 mA
GA/FA bell, PA spkr, Tel, EAP = engineer alarm panel
Hot fresh water DN15 Cu + 25 mm insulation
Grey water drain DN50 → grey water tank
Black water DN100 → STP (MARPOL Annex IV)
1. All dims in mm unless noted. Clear room heights 2300 mm. Suite area 32.4 m² (MLC 2006 Reg.3.1 min. for senior officer satisfied).
2. Electrical installation to IEC 60092-201/-401/-507 and class rules (DNV-RU-SHIP Pt.4 Ch.8). Cables halogen-free, flame retardant IEC 60092-350/-353, IEC 60332-3-22.
3. Fresh water to ISO 15748-1/-2; potable water hygiene per WHO Guide to Ship Sanitation. Sanitary drains per ISO 15749. Penetrations type-approved (FTP Code).
4. Fire insulation, doors and penetrations per SOLAS II-2 Reg. 9; ref. Method Statement MS-CE-001. SAFETY-CRITICAL ITEMS TO BE VERIFIED BY CLASS-APPROVED ENGINEER.
Generic 190 m cargo vessel - Accommodation deck 'C', STBD, Fr120-131
DWG No: CE-SUITE-GA-001 REV: A (Issued for review) SHEET 1 / 1
